author: Ashen Spire Games
title: Paid concept / environment artist for Ashen Skies
content: PAID ARTIST CALL — ASHEN SKIES. Ashen Spire Games is looking for a human concept artist / environment artist for Ashen Skies, our Gothic dark-fantasy siege game. Experience in gothic architecture, dark fantasy environments, medieval siege scenes, fortress/cathedral design, atmospheric key art. Character or creature design is a bonus. Paid freelance; small paid test piece first. No generative AI. Reply or DM with portfolio, availability, rates, typical turnaround time.
